names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 iulie, «Sfântul Mucenic Calinic», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Καλλίνικος», with the rank word left off. The page glosses it: κάλλος + νίκη, the fair and glorious victor.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 29. јул ст. ст., „Св. муч. Калиник.“ — «Св.» is “saint” and «муч.» the rank `martyr` the folder already carries, both left off by BRIEF-SERBIAN §6, and the heading gives nothing else at all, so the bare forename is the whole of the form. «Киликије» stands in the body as «Родом из Киликије», a prepositional phrase, and is not turned into an adjective to make a fuller form. MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN AND AGAIN AFTER: `fk.mjs` on «Калиник» returns the key «калиник» at one holder, `callinicus-of-caesarea`; of the nine Callinicus folders the corpus holds, that one is the only other to carry a Serbian form at all. The fold becomes two wide with this form and the key «калиник callinicus-of-caesarea callinicus-of-cilicia» is declared in the same commit with both holders read. No earlier key for this string existed, because one holder is no collision.

Name page 1158 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Каллиник Киликийский, Гангрский, мч.»; the grade is stripped and both epithets kept, that being the fullest form the calendar gives, per BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2. The day line itself gives «Каллиника» bare. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Мч. Каллиника (III-IV).»

attestations.note: The day's first entry, and the same menologion day as all three of the folder's other venerated rows. «Мч.» is the `martyr` the folder already carries. A DATE DISAGREEMENT RECORDED AND CHANGED NOWHERE: this line gives «(III-IV)», the third to fourth century, where the folder holds «c. 250» off the Ohrid Prologue; the folder's year sits inside the calendar's span, so the two do not contradict each other and NO `dates` WERE CHANGED. Name page 1158 adds «Гангрский», of Gangra, to the Cilicia the folder's display name carries, and the folder was NOT renamed. The reading life4341 was NOT opened, the folder's life being already written. TWO HYMNS TAKEN where the folder had none of this calendar's; the first is the common of one martyr, «Мученик Твой, Господи», printed with his name set into it, and its citation says so.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 29 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Calinic»

attestations.note: Not the Callinicus this corpus keeps on 23 august, who is the patriarch of Constantinople; doxologia's life here is of a layman of Cilicia who preached at Ancyra and was burned in a furnace.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Καλλίνικος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: «Ο Άγιος Καλλίνικος κατάγονταν από την Κιλικία», taken before the governor Σακέρδων — the Sacerdon of the Romanian life — and thrown at the last into a furnace. The two accounts differ on where he was seized: doxologia has it at Ancyra in Galatia, saint.gr «Όταν έφθασε στην Αίγυπτο», when he had reached Egypt, and it adds the nailed shoes, the eighty stadia to Gangra, the iron claws and the wild horse, and the synaxis near the bridge of Justinian by a place called Petrion. The difference is recorded here and in the life; neither page is corrected by the other. The page gives no year or century anywhere, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. It prints an apolytikion and a kontakion, both of which name him, and both are taken.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.08.2026 (29. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Калиник.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (§4). THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE DOSSIER AND NOT THE NAME: the corpus holds nine Callinicus folders, and this entry is this one on four particulars its own life already carries — «Родом из Киликије», a Cilician by birth; taken at Ancyra by a pagan prince the book calls «Сакердон», whom the folder’s life already names as Sacerdon out of doxologia and saint.gr; the iron shoes with nails inside them and the forced march to Gangra, which saint.gr already gave as eighty stadia in nailed shoes; and the heated furnace he walked into with a thanksgiving in his mouth. The folder’s Romanian and Greek rows are already 29 July, the same menologion number, and its `serbian` row was `undocumented`, so nothing was moved. THE NEAR FOLDER IS `callinicus-of-caesarea` AND IT IS NOT HIM: the servant of the idols at Caesarea in Bithynia, converted by the wonders done through Thyrsus, whom this same book keeps on the Julian 14 December with Thyrsus and Leucius, dated to the middle of the third century — a convert of a company of three on another day, against a lifelong Christian preacher who travelled alone. `dates` ADDED WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE: its `dates` was `null`, and the entry’s last sentence gives «Чесно пострада и увенча се венцем вечне славе око 250. год.», he suffered honourably and was crowned about the year 250, so a `death` of 250 goes in as `traditional`, the first date of any kind this folder has had. `types` UNTOUCHED: «муч.» is the `martyr` already held, and the `preacher` beside it is what this entry shows him doing. No `locations`: Cilicia is a birthplace in a prepositional phrase, Ancyra and Gangra are stations of a journey, and none is written as a coordinate. The stored Serbian form is the heading’s bare forename, which widens the string «калиник» from one holder to two, and the key is declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this same commit with both holders read. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Calinic, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Calinic», Glasul 4 — the common of one martyr, as the page prints it for him

english.text: Your martyr Callinicus, Lord, in his struggle received from You, our God, the crown of incorruption. For having Your power he overthrew the tormentors, and he broke also the powerless daring of the demons. By his prayers, Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Κλῆσιν σύνδρομον, ἔχων τῷ βίῳ, νίκος καλλίστον, ἤρας ἐν ἄθλοις, καταλλήλως γεγονῶς ὁ προκέκλησαι, σὺ γὰρ καλῶς τὸν ἀγῶνα τελέσας σου, ὡς νικητὴς ἐδοξάσθης Καλλίνικε. Μάρτυς ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — on the page of «Άγιος Καλλίνικος», and it names him

english.text: Having a calling that ran together with your life, you bore away the fairest victory in your contests, becoming in fact what you had been called beforehand; for you finished your struggle well and were glorified as a victor, Callinicus. Glorious martyr, entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Τὰ ἄνω τερπνά, ἀξίως νῦν κεκλήρωσαι· Χριστοῦ γὰρ σφοδρῶς, τῷ πόθῳ πυρακτούμενος, τοῦ πυρὸς Καλλίνικε, δι᾽ αὐτοῦ ἀνδρείως κατετόλμησας· ᾧ καὶ νῦν παριστάμενος, μὴ παύσῃ πρεσβεύων, ὑπὲρ τῶν πάντων ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν — the second hymn on the page of «Άγιος Καλλίνικος», and it names him

english.text: The delights above you have now worthily inherited; for being set ablaze with a fierce longing for Christ, Callinicus, you bravely dared the fire for his sake. Standing now before him, do not cease to intercede for us all.

hymns.text: Мученик Твой, Господи, Каллиник/ во страдании своем венец прият нетленный от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имеяй бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложи,/ сокруши и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Того молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Тропарь мученика Каллиника», глас 4; this is «Мученик Твой, Господи», the common of one martyr, printed with his name set into it

english.text: Thy martyr Callinicus, O Lord, in his suffering has received an incorruptible crown from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, he cast down the tormentors and shattered also the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Горняя красная достойно ныне наследовал еси,/ Христовою бо зело любовию разжегся,/ на огнь, Каллиниче, тем мужественно дерзнул еси,/ Емуже и ныне предстоя,// не престай моля о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Кондак мученика Каллиника», глас 2

english.text: Thou hast now worthily inherited the beauty of the heights, for being set greatly aflame with the love of Christ thou didst therefore dare the fire manfully, O Callinicus; and standing now before Him, do not cease to pray for us all.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 29. јул ст. ст.: «Чесно пострада и увенча се венцем вечне славе око 250. год.» — he suffered honourably and was crowned with the crown of eternal glory about the year 250. «око», about, is why the basis is traditional and not attested. The folder held no `dates` of any kind before this; neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives him a year.
